{{Top|leg}}
A '''Republic recon patrol''' (also called a '''Republic exploratory patrol''') was a unit of mounted [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that used local [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[:Category:Creatures|wildlife]] as their mounts. They favored the use of accurate [[Longblaster/Legends|longblasters]] such as the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A blaster rifle]] and [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]] since the ability to hit a foe at a great distance was highly valued in their reconnaissance missions.
